tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Migros products by name or keyword. Returns product IDs that can be used with get_product_details.

language.description: Language for results (de, fr, it, en). Default: de

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get full product details including nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens, price, and ratings. Use search_products first to get product IDs.

productIds.description: Array of product IDs (UIDs) to get details for. Get these from search_products first.

tools.name: get_stock
tools.description: Check product stock at a specific Migros store. Use search_products and search_stores first to get the IDs. Stock is approximate and updated once a day.

productId.description: Product UID to check stock for. Get this from search_products.

storeId.description: Store ID (costCenterId) to check stock at. Get this from search_stores.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all Migros product categories

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Find Migros stores by location (city name, zip code, etc.). Returns store details including address and opening hours.

query.description: Search query for Migros stores (city name, zip code, etc.)

tools.name: get_promotions
tools.description: Search current Migros promotions and deals. Optionally filter by search query.

query.description: Optional search query to filter promotions

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search Migusto (Migros' recipe site) by free-text query and/or ingredients. Returns recipe id, slug, title, cooking time, rating. Use get_recipe_details for full info or get_recipe_products to get Migros product UIDs to add to the basket.

ingredients.description: Filter to recipes that use these ingredients.

language.description: Language code: de, fr, it. Default: de.

tools.name: get_recipe_details
tools.description: Fetch a full Migusto recipe by slug: ingredients with quantities, step-by-step instructions, photos, nutrition. Use search_recipes first to find the slug. (Migusto is Migros' recipe site at migusto.migros.ch.)

slug.description: Recipe slug from search_recipes (the URL-safe id).

tools.name: get_recipe_products
tools.description: Fetch the Migros products needed for a Migusto recipe — returns product UIDs you can pass directly to add_to_basket. Bridges recipes to shopping. Use the recipe ID from search_recipes (NOT the slug).

recipeId.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes. NOT the slug.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get the logged-in customer's basic profile (name, email, language, cooperative). Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_addresses
tools.description: Get the user's saved delivery and billing addresses. Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_basket
tools.description: Fetch the items currently in the user's shopping basket (Migros calls this a shopping list). Returns product IDs and quantities; use get_product_details to enrich. Requires authentication.

shoppingListId.description: Optional shopping list ID. Omit to fetch the user's primary list.

tools.name: add_to_basket
tools.description: Add a product to the user's basket (or set its quantity if already present). The underlying API is upsert-to-target, not increment. Returns the updated basket. Requires authentication.

quantity.description: Target quantity. Defaults to 1. REPLACES existing quantity, not increment.

shoppingListId.description: Optional list ID; omit to use the primary list.

tools.name: update_basket_quantity
tools.description: Set an item's exact quantity in the basket. quantity=0 removes the item. Returns the updated basket. Requires authentication.

quantity.description: Exact target quantity. 0 removes the item.

tools.name: remove_from_basket
tools.description: Remove a product from the user's basket. Returns the updated basket. Requires authentication.

productId.description: Product UID to remove from the basket.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: List the user's online orders, paginated, filtered by status. Use to find an order id, then call get_order_details. Requires authentication.

status.description: Filter by order status. Default: ALL.

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a single order by id. Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the URL the user should open in their browser to complete checkout (review basket, confirm address/slot, pay). Order placement requires payment confirmation in a real browser, so this tool hands off rather than firing the order automatically. Returns a basket summary alongside the URL. Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_cumulus_status
tools.description: Get the user's Cumulus loyalty card status: points balance, level, cardholder, lifetime stats. Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_in_store_receipts
tools.description: List the user's in-store Migros receipts (Kassenbons) over a date range. Default: last 30 days. Use get_receipt_details with an id for line items. Requires authentication.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ago.

tools.name: get_receipt_details
tools.description: Get the URL to view a single in-store receipt's line items in the browser. Line items aren't accessible via the API — get_in_store_receipts gives store/date/amount/points which is enough for most queries. Requires authentication.

tools.name: get_cumulus_coupons
tools.description: List active Cumulus coupons targeted at the user (personalized offers based on shopping history). Requires authentication.
